text: Hydro-Québec Series JU — C$500M, 4.00% coupon, priced at 84.479 to yield 4.900%, maturing 15 February 2065. Seventeenth reopening of a series first issued 19 September 2024; aggregate nominal value now C$9.0B. Full syndicate disclosed.
Boralex subordinated debt — La Caisse and Fondaction invested C$250M on 7 July 2025, eight months before the take-private was agreed. Also added Parc éolien Apuiat, commissioned 29 October 2025.

Boralex was logged as confidential and closed. Both wrong. The 25 March release discloses C$37.25 per share, a 31.8% premium, C$9.0B enterprise value and 13× 2026E EBITDA. Reclassified as pending — all regulatory approvals obtained 7 August 2026, closing expected Q4 2026.

Innergex consideration reduced to unverified. Following the CDPQ take-private, Innergex's press room retains only five items and the investor relations section is gone. The record of its own sale is no longer on its own site.

Novacap's release archive cuts against the inbound framing: most recent activity is outbound — US$1.9B for IAS, the HyscaleIX data centre platform in US markets, fibre in Idaho, towers in Kentucky, plus a US$3.8B technology fund closed February 2026.

Des Neiges traced to origin: Boralex, Énergir and Hydro-Québec agreed to develop three 400 MW wind projects on the Seigneurie de Beaupré on 19 April 2022. Four years from partnership to groundbreaking.

Hydro-Québec publishes an RSS feed of press releases — the first machine-readable source found. Bond issues appear with amount, coupon, price, yield, maturity and full syndicate. Highest-priority source for automated collection.
Northland Power removed from the source list. Visible recent output is Baltic Power in Poland and Hai Long in Taiwan — outside this tracker's scope.
Initial load — Quebec energy, digital infrastructure and mid-market control transactions, plus four pipeline entries.
